'''Regnant Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as a refueling outpost in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the station's location and [[Attack on Regnant Station|attacked it]], destroying the station.
